decisions.rationale: ROOT independently reproduced three out-of-policy UART argument sets returning ALLOW. This is a functionality-breaking default-deny failure immediately before physical MCP dispatch. The localized candidate validator/test repair is substantially lower risk and cost than allowing unbounded or malformed UART effects.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add one narrow policy-driven UART argument validator for read_serial, write_serial, serial_exchange, and populated plan variants; add focused negative/valid host-only tests. Do not change the MCP fixture, topology, or protected original tests.
